name: Coconut Cookies
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), INVERT SYRUP, DESICCATED COCONUT POWDER (1.4%), STARCH, RAISING AGENTS [INS 503 (ii), INS 500(ii)]. IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS (INS 322, INS 471), MILK SOLIDS, DOUGH CONDITIONER (INS 223), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (COCONUT & VANILLA), ACIDITY REGULATOR [INS 450(i)].
